Generations of children have been shaped, inspired and educated by St. Julian’s; a thriving community that feels like family and lasts a lifetime. Each child is nurtured, supported and educated as an individual. The equation is simple: a happy, fulfilled child can - and will - achieve academic excellence. Our students are encouraged to reach their full potential in an environment that inspires and supports them while instilling a lifelong love of learning and knowledge.

Nestled between beautiful Carcavelos beach and historic Lisbon, St. Julian’s stunning campus boasts one of the most impressive locations in Europe. A truly unique blend of natural beauty and urban convenience.

At the heart of our school sits an elegant 18th-century palace surrounded by gardens, sports facilities, woodland areas, and fresh sea air. Our vast grounds and fantastic location provide endless opportunities to enrich your child’s education.
Surf, rugby, football, cricket, athletics to name just a few, plus the joy of Forest School, a mud kitchen and pond-dipping for the little ones.

For almost a century St. Julian’s has been both educating children and producing tomorrow’s leaders from diverse international backgrounds. Since 1932, great artists, entrepreneurs, scientists, politicians, Hollywood screenwriters, Internet pioneers and AI engineers have been shaped and inspired by our teaching values and ethos. Our wealth of experience and rich academic heritage provide the bedrock and stability enabling us to so successfully embrace a modern, future-focussed approach to learning for the digital age.
“I believe St. Julian's offers opportunities like no other school”
“A thriving international culture, which I deeply cherish.”
“The most empowering gift St. Julian's gave me was the confidence that I can tackle anything with enthusiasm.”

We know how important a rich and rewarding school life should be outside the classroom and we offer a full programme of activities. There is something for everyone; from artists to athletes, musicians to Model United Nations, drama to the Duke of Edinburgh Award and much much more.

pages.title: Welcome from the Head - St. Julian's School
blocks: We want to equip our children not just with an academic education but also with the life skills, resilience and flexibility they will need to succeed in a rapidly changing, complex world. We place equal emphasis on intellectual and emotional growth as well as critical thinking and citizenship.
Welcome to St. Julian’s School, Portugal’s leading British international school since 1932.

As you explore our website, you will discover that our school takes great pride in its rich history and heritage, spanning nearly 95 years. We focus on the future and are dedicated to developing well-rounded individuals who are not only successful and happy but also capable of making a positive impact in the world. According to our Shaper Profile, we strive to educate children to be compassionate, curious, collaborative communicators, and above all, to have the courage to be active global citizens and create an impact in the world.

Our highly talented staff, lovely families, and excellent facilities are located in one of Europe’s most beautiful regions. We currently serve a Portuguese and international community representing over 60 nationalities.

Our pupils and students, aged 3 to 18, benefit from a variety of academically rich programmes. In the British Section, we follow the National Curriculum for England, which leads to IGCSEs. For Years 12 and 13, we offer the IB Diploma and the IB Career-related Programme. Additionally, our Bilingual Section spans from Primary to Secondary, providing a curriculum that enables families to access the Portuguese National Curriculum while participating in joint classes, sports, and arts with the British Section, culminating in IGCSEs and the IB.

Our examination results for students aged 16-18 are among the best in international schools worldwide. These achievements highlight not only the hard work and dedication of our students but also the high standards of teaching and support provided by our staff.

We endeavour to value differences, respect others’ opinions and beliefs, and create a campus environment where our children always feel safe. This atmosphere enables our students to develop into global citizens.

In 2025/26, for the fourth consecutive year, St. Julian’s has been recognised as one of the top 10 private schools in Europe by Spear’s and as one of the top 15 international schools in Europe by Carfax
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions about life at St. Julian’s. One of my colleagues will be happy to assist you.

In an increasingly competitive international school landscape, we distinguish ourselves as a not-for-profit institution. This means that every penny of your fees is reinvested directly into your child’s education, ensuring the highest calibre of teaching and a commitment to their academic development.
Meanwhile, I hope you enjoy exploring our website, and I look forward to welcoming you to our beautiful school in Carcavelos soon.
We are rooted in excellence at St. Julian’s School with strong values and a clear strategy for the future.

Our Shaper Profile and Learning Essentials guide how we nurture and teach our students. As our Shaper Profile states, we seek to educate children that are “compassionate, curious, collaborative communicators and who, above all, have the courage to be active citizens to make a difference in the world.”

Our students thrive in the wonderful international ethos of St. Julian’s. It is a warm, welcoming community that feels like a family. Embedded in our school badge is our historic lighthouse symbol, which expresses the guidance and enlightenment we have been providing for generations.

Our strategy directs all plans and decisions at the School. It is founded on three pillars: Teaching & Learning, Wellbeing and Organisation for Learning. These create a solid foundation for ensuring academic excellence and enable every child to flourish.
Main Pillars of Our Strategic Plan
"The cross-cultural understanding I gained at St. Julian’s has been instrumental in helping me work effectively with people from diverse cultures and belief systems."
